name: monet
description: Monet — a local-first cross-platform Markdown vault with an interactive link graph, CLI and MCP server.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @monet/core build && pnpm --filter @monet/cli build && pnpm --filter @monet/app build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @monet/core test && pnpm --filter @monet/cli test && pnpm --filter @monet/app test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @monet/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @monet/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @monet/app typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

author: Monet contributors
